_about: Selection rules for the discovery scan (2022-2023). The scan refuses to run until no TBD is left and this file is committed. Options for every TBD: docs/selection_menu.md. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_test_grid: Already decided (CLAUDE.md): all categories plus taxonomy families, the earnings split, all five strategies, all three buckets, the organizers' horizons, the starter's OTM grid, tradeable 'post' entry, the playground measurements.
_earnings_tags: Which tags mark a filing as co-filed with earnings (Item 2.02).
_samples: min_sets: tests with fewer matched sets are not run. low_sample_n: below this a result is flagged low-sample.
_inference: p_value: 'p_perm' (exact permutation) or 'p_z' (normal approximation to the permutation draws). fdr_family: 'all', 'per_level', 'per_metric' or 'headline' (BH only inside the headline grid below; everything else is exploratory).
headline: TBD
_confirmation: How a candidate is confirmed on the 2024-2025 in-sample window (one test per candidate, same matched-null design, nothing on or after 2026-01-01). p_max_one_sided: one-sided p in the candidate's direction. multiple_testing across candidates: 'none', 'holm' or 'bonferroni'.
